description: This file implements a gRPC server for controlling environment proxy services, including listing services, methods, request/response types, and invoking methods via gRPC. It defines a service class with multiple RPC handlers and a main function to run the server.

classes.name: ControlEnvProxyServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the ControlEnvProxyService gRPC service, handling RPC calls for method invocation, listing services, methods, request/response types, and type information.

methods.name: ControlEnvProxyServiceImpl::CallUnaryMethod
methods.description: Handles unary gRPC call to invoke a method on the control environment proxy.

methods.name: ControlEnvProxyServiceImpl::ListServices
methods.description: Lists available gRPC services by invoking a command and parsing JSON output.

methods.name: ControlEnvProxyServiceImpl::ListMethods
methods.description: Lists methods of a specified service.

methods.name: ControlEnvProxyServiceImpl::ListReqResType
methods.description: Retrieves request and response message types for a specific method.

methods.name: ControlEnvProxyServiceImpl::TypeInformation
methods.description: Provides detailed type information for a specified type.

methods.name: RunServer
methods.description: Sets up and runs the gRPC server, including socket permissions and server startup.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that initializes and runs the gRPC server.
